prompt: Create an original 150 second orchestral adventure instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: strings, French horn, timpani, flute. Style: rising motifs, dynamic arcs and clear melodic development. Tempo approximately 100 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A grand and majestic orchestral piece featuring sweeping strings, powerful brass, and dynamic percussion. It builds from a stately opening to a triumphant and epic climax, evoking a sense of heroism and drama.
description.zh: 一首宏伟庄严的管弦乐作品，以悠扬的弦乐、雄壮的铜管和富有动感的打击乐为特色。乐曲从庄重的开场逐渐发展到凯旋史诗般的高潮，营造出英雄主义和戏剧性的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
